text:
jessica_cs: Morning team — quick NebulaPay VPC health snapshot. Noting regional diffs after last night's KMS rotation. TL;DR: us-east healthy, eu-west degraded (HSM switchover), ap-south intermittent networking. Thoughts + ops items below.

raj_engineer: Logs: HSM certificate rotation triggered automatic failover at 02:14 UTC. KV cache persisted. Affected sessions 3. p95 latency jumped to 720ms for ~6min.

emily_kms: Confirmed — rotation completed but hardware target didn't bind cleanly. HSM vendor reset at 02:22 fixed binding. Opened vendor ticket #HSM-789.

noah_support: Customer saw 502s on webhook delivery in eu-west-2. Support case 5624 created. I sent mitigation: increase webhook retries and enable fallback region routing.

jessica_cs: Usage/spend: spend up 12% MoM due to higher retry volume in eu-west resulting in extra tokens. Quick numbers: us-east tokens 1.2M, eu-west 310k (was 170k), ap-south 80k. Latency snapshot: us-east p50 45ms / p95 180ms, eu-west p50 210ms / p95 740ms (incident window), ap-south p50 120ms / p95 420ms. Error rate (last 24h): us-east 0.2%, eu-west 4.6%, ap-south 2.1%.

neil_prod_mgr: :warning: Renewal note — NebulaPay's account shows rising cost but reduced overall success rate last 30d (SLA misses). We should propose a short-term credits + runbook offer. What do we recommend?

raj_engineer: Recommend: schedule HSM reprovision window, add continuous registry check, and enable cross-region fallback for critical webhook routes. I can gate a small routing policy change today.

emily_kms: Also recommend updating rotation runbook — add `redwoodctl kms health --json` checks and double-check cert lifecycle timings. Snippet: 
```
redwoodctl kms health --region eu-west-2 && redwoodctl kms rotate --dry-run
```
This will catch bind failures in staging before prod rotation.

noah_support: I can run enablement session with NebulaPay ops tomorrow (30m) to walk through fallback routing and retry backoffs. Will book and share calendar invite.

jessica_cs: Action items: 1) raj — routing policy change (today) 2) emily — runbook update + vendor follow-up 3) noah — enablement session + customer credits proposal. I'll draft a short one-page remediation + credit offer to reduce renewal risk. Customer health doc: https://redwood.internal/cs/nebulapay/health (will update after fixes).

deploy-bot: deploy finished: routing-policy-change on prod (rev b32a) — 1719005123

raj_engineer: Routing change deployed, monitoring. Early signal: error-rate eu-west reduced to 1.1% from 4.6% over last 15m. p95 back to ~210ms.

jessica_cs: :thumbsup: great. Recheck end-of-day and I'll include in renewal risk deck. If eu-west flaps again, escalate to SRE.
